did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A shopper saved the Matte silicone phone case to their wishlist (price 1,224 with commission). The seller then lowered their price from 1,200 to 1,000 on their own screen. The daily price-drop job was run, and the shopper opened their messages.

checks.text: Save to wishlist remembered the price the shopper saw (1,224)
The seller changed the public price from 1,200 to 1,000 and the listing stayed published
The job told 1 shopper on its first run and nobody on the second (once per drop)
The shopper's message reads: "Matte silicone phone case" is cheaper now: 1,020.00 instead of 1,224.00 (the new price with the 2% commission, against the old one)

notes: Done in the live browser for the shopper's and the seller's sides. The job that runs each morning was started by a command instead of waiting for the morning. The seller's price is left at 1,000.

shots.caption: Shopper: Save to wishlist on the listing
